findings.evidence: `grep -n gWit` finds it only in DIS/Tensors/Basic.lean and the new Jets/Frame/Witness.lean (the Reciprocity.lean hits are `ContractingWith_timelikeMap`). DIS/Tensors/Basic.lean:755 defines it with `LinearMap.mk₂` over `ℝ × ℝ × ℝ` and uses no Tensors declaration.
findings.fix: Move `gWit`, `gWit_apply` and `gWit_isSymm` to `DIS/Kinematics/Basic.lean` (e.g. a `Kinematics.Witness` namespace next to the `Bilin` abbrev), update the uses in `DIS/Tensors/Basic.lean` in this PR, and let `Jets/Frame/Witness.lean` import only `DIS.Kinematics.Basic` plus `Jets.Frame.Basic` — the same mechanical earlier-file move this PR already performs for `apply_sub_smul_pair`.
findings.issue: `public import EpsilonEridani.QFT.Scattering.DIS.Tensors.Basic` exists solely to reach `gWit`/`gWit_isSymm` (the `open` on line 28 names nothing else), so a Jets-layer file now depends on the entire inclusive-DIS hadronic-tensor development (F1/F2 basis, `exists_isF1F2Decomposition`, `decomposition_unique`) for a 3-dimensional Minkowski form. `gWit` is a broadly useful concrete `+--` form that depends on nothing in `Tensors`, yet lives in `Tensors.Hadronic.Witness`, a section documented as the `IsLorentzCovariant` vacuity audit (DIS/Tensors/Basic.lean:750-770).

findings.evidence: DIS/Tensors/Basic.lean:84-86 opens `Kinematics (Bilin)` and then declares `namespace Bilin`, which resolves to `...DIS.Tensors.Bilin`, distinct from the abbrev's `...DIS.Kinematics.Bilin` where this PR puts `projOrthogonal` (Kinematics/Basic.lean:35-115).
findings.fix: In this PR, move the remaining generic declarations (`rankOne`, `rankOne_apply`, `rankOne_isSymm`, `IsIsometry`, `isIsometry_id`, `reflect`, `reflect_apply`, `reflect_apply_self`, `reflect_apply_of_orthogonal`, `reflect_isometry`) into `Kinematics.Bilin` in `DIS/Kinematics/Basic.lean` and update their uses, so `Bilin`'s API has one home; a pure namespace move, no declaration renames.
findings.issue: The PR makes `Kinematics.Bilin` (the abbrev's own namespace) the home for generic bilinear-form API by moving `apply_sub_smul_pair` there and adding `projOrthogonal`, but leaves the rest of the equally DIS-independent API — `rankOne`, `IsIsometry`, `isIsometry_id`, `reflect` and its lemmas — in the unrelated `Tensors.Bilin` namespace of `DIS/Tensors/Basic.lean:86-177`. `projOrthogonal` and `reflect` are the same `Module.preReflection u f` construction and now sit in different files and namespaces, which is how a second copy of the projection gets written; the cross-namespace call at DIS/Tensors/Basic.lean:174 (`Kinematics.Bilin.apply_sub_smul_pair` inside `namespace Bilin`) makes the split visible.

summary: The Jets frame files are in the roadmap-named home and the projection move is clean, but two pieces of shared Bilin-level material are left in the wrong home: gWit stays buried in the hadronic-tensor covariance audit (pulling all of DIS/Tensors/Basic into Jets for a three-line metric), and the generic Bilin API is now split across Kinematics.Bilin and Tensors.Bilin.
